description: Knowledge base for FastNet ISP — used by the AI voice agent to answer customer queries accurately.

rules.rule: Refunds are only applicable for service outages that exceed 24 continuous hours. No refund is issued for outages of 24 hours or less.
If a customer cancels their plan within the first 6 months of activation, a cancellation fee of ₹1500 is charged. No cancellation fee applies after 6 months.
FastNet offers two consumer plans: the Basic plan provides speeds of 50 Mbps, and the Pro plan provides speeds of 200 Mbps.
FastNet guarantees a customer callback within a 2-hour window from the time of the request. No specific time slot is guaranteed — only the 2-hour window.
New broadband installations take between 3 to 5 business days from the date of order confirmation. Weekends and public holidays are excluded.
A 10% loyalty discount is applied to the monthly bill only after a customer has maintained an active subscription for 12 continuous months. The discount does not apply before the 12-month mark.
FastNet bills on a monthly cycle. Auto-debit is processed on the 5th of every month from the customer's registered payment method.
For service outages exceeding 24 continuous hours, FastNet provides compensation of ₹100 per day for each additional day of downtime beyond the initial 24-hour period.
